optimizedCv.targetRoleTitle: Technical Project Manager, Supply Chain Collaboration

professionalSummary.text: Experienced Technical Project Manager with a proven track record of reducing supplier onboarding time by 37% through systematic milestone planning and integration coordination.
professionalSummary.witness: Average supplier onboarding time fell from 46 days to 29 days across the seventeen suppliers onboarded after the standard mapping templates were introduced, as recorded in the programme tracker against the recorded baseline of 46 days for the first six suppliers.

experienceHighlights.text: Planned onboarding projects for 23 suppliers across two manufacturer customers, maintaining a detailed milestone schedule for each supplier.
experienceHighlights.witness: Planned onboarding projects for twenty-three suppliers across two manufacturer customers, maintaining the milestone schedule (connectivity test, mapping sign-off, parallel run, go-live) for each supplier in the programme tracker.

experienceHighlights.text: Tracked integration milestones with three integration engineers, updating supplier status weekly and driving recovery actions.
experienceHighlights.witness: Tracked integration milestones with the three integration engineers, updating supplier status in the tracker each week, raising slipped milestones in the weekly project review and agreeing recovery dates with the supplier contact and the engineer concerned.

experienceHighlights.text: Coordinated onboarding decisions with programme lead and customer operations, ensuring clear responsibility boundaries and go-live confirmations.
experienceHighlights.witness: Coordinated onboarding decisions with the programme lead and customer operations; the programme lead decided supplier sequencing and customer operations confirmed each go-live with the manufacturer.

experienceHighlights.text: Authored completion notes for each supplier, documenting limitations and hand-over points for support teams.
experienceHighlights.witness: Wrote the completion note for each onboarded supplier, listing open mapping limitations and the hand-over points for the support team.

projectsAndWorkSamples.text: Programme tracker export demonstrating onboarding days per supplier, baseline line, and template introduction marker, accompanied by a supplier completion note.
projectsAndWorkSamples.witness: Work sample: the programme tracker export (onboarding days per supplier, baseline line, template introduction marker) and one supplier completion note, with the tracker's record identifiers as a verification trail.

optimizedCv.evidenceBoundary: The provided resume and work sample documents establish the candidate’s experience in planning and tracking supplier onboarding projects, coordinating with engineers and stakeholders, reducing onboarding time, and documenting completion details. They do not provide independent verification of the baseline figures or the candidate’s travel availability beyond the recruiter note.
